task.title: Full Project Management Tool
task.buildPrompt: Build a multi-page project management app: (1) a login screen (mock auth, any email/password combo succeeds, invalid formats rejected), (2) after login, a dashboard listing projects with create/delete, (3) clicking a project opens a Kanban board (To Do/In Progress/Done) scoped to that project with drag-and-drop, due dates, and priority tags (Low/Med/High, color-coded), (4) a reporting page showing task-completion rate charts per project, (5) a persistent top nav with logout. task.title: E-Commerce Storefront with Checkout Flow
task.buildPrompt: Build a full storefront: product listing with filters/search/sort (price low-high, high-low), product detail page (route per product with variant selection e.g. size/color), cart persisting across page navigation, a 3-step checkout (shipping info → payment mock form with card-number format validation → order review), and an order confirmation page with a generated order number. Include an order history page listing past mock orders.

checks.description: Page loads without console errors
Product listing grid with search & filter controls visible
checks.actual: Products count: 1, search input visible: false

checks.description: Price sort dropdown reorders product grid
Clicking product opens Product Detail page with size/color options
Adding variant to cart updates cart badge count
checks.error:
locator.textContent: Timeout 2000ms exceeded.
Call log:
[2m  - waiting for locator('[class*="badge"], [class*="cart-count"], button:has-text("Cart")').first()[22m

checks.description: Cart state persists when navigating back to product grid
checks.error:
locator.textContent: Timeout 2000ms exceeded.
Call log:
[2m  - waiting for locator('[class*="badge"], [class*="cart-count"], button:has-text("Cart")').first()[22m

checks.description: Checkout Step 1 (Shipping Info) accepts address and advances
Payment step validates credit card format
Completing checkout displays Order Confirmation with Order #
checks.expected: Order confirmation with generated order number

checks.description: 'Order History' page lists past completed orders
checks.expected: Order history rendered with completed order

task.title: Collaborative Document Editor (Simulated)
task.buildPrompt: Build a simplified collaborative text editor: a document list sidebar, a rich-text editing area (bold/italic/underline/bullet list toolbar), auto-save indicator ('Saving...' → 'Saved' after 1s of inactivity), a simulated 'second user' cursor/highlight that appears in the doc after 5 seconds to mimic collaboration, version history showing last 3 saved versions with the ability to restore an older version, and a share-link generator that copies a mock URL to clipboard.

checks.description: Page loads without console errors
Document list sidebar visible with selectable docs
Rich-text toolbar present (Bold, Italic, Underline, Bullet list)
Typing text triggers auto-save ('Saving...' → 'Saved')
Simulated 'second user' cursor or presence indicator appears
checks.expected: Collaborator presence or cursor indicator visible

checks.description: 'Version History' panel lists saved document versions
checks.expected: Version history panel lists saved versions

checks.description: Restoring an older version replaces editor content
Share-link button generates mock URL and shows copy confirmation
